features.name: Paladin Starting Traits
features.description:
**Primary Ability:** Strength and Charisma
**Hit Point Die:** d10 per Paladin level
**Saving Throw Proficiencies:** Wisdom and Charisma
**Skill Proficiencies:** Choose 2 from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, or Religion
**Weapon Proficiencies:** Simple and Martial weapons
**Armor Training:** Light, Medium, and Heavy armor and Shields
**Starting Equipment:** Choose A or B: (A) Chain Mail, Shield, Longsword, 6 Javelins, Holy Symbol, Priest's Pack, and 9 GP; or (B) 150 GP

choices.name: First Skill
choices.description: Choose one from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, or Religion.

choices.name: Second Skill
choices.description: Choose another from the paladin skill list.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description:
Your blessed touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power equal to five times your Paladin level that replenishes on a Long Rest.

As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and restore Hit Points from the pool. You can also expend 5 HP from the pool to remove the Poisoned condition.

payload.name: Lay on Hands
payload.description: Touch a creature to restore HP from pool (5 × paladin level). Or spend 5 HP to remove Poisoned condition.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
You have learned to cast spells through prayer and meditation. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

**Spell save DC** = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier
**Spell attack modifier** = your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier

**Prepared Spells:** Fixed by class table. Starting at 2 at L1, scaling to 15 at L20. Chosen from the Paladin spell list. Changed after each Long Rest.

You can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description:
You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the Blessed Warrior option:

**Blessed Warrior.** You learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice (Guidance and Sacred Flame recommended). The chosen cantrips count as Paladin spells for you, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them.

choices.name: Fighting Style Feat or Blessed Warrior
choices.description: Choose a Fighting Style feat or Blessed Warrior.

features.name: Paladin's Smite
features.description: You always have the *Divine Smite* spell prepared. In addition, you can cast it without expending a spell slot, but you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes. You start with one effect: Divine Sense. Other Paladin features give additional Channel Divinity options.

Uses: 2 (L3-10), 3 (L11+). Regain 1 use on Short Rest, all on Long Rest.

**Divine Sense.** Bonus Action: detect Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60 ft for 10 minutes. Also detect consecrated/desecrated places.

payload.name: Channel Divinity: Divine Sense
payload.description: Detect Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60 ft for 10 minutes. Also detect consecrated/desecrated areas.

features.name: Paladin Subclass
features.description: You gain a Paladin subclass of your choice. The Oath of Devotion subclass is detailed after this class's description.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 4)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Faithful Steed
features.description:
You can call on the aid of an otherworldly steed. You always have the *Find Steed* spell prepared.

You can also cast the spell once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description:
You radiate a protective, unseeable aura in a 10-foot Emanation that originates from you. The aura is inactive while you have the Incapacitated condition.

You and your allies in the aura gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 8)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat.

features.name: Abjure Foes
features.description: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe. Target a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1) within 60 ft. Each target makes a WIS save or is Frightened for 1 minute or until it takes damage. While Frightened, it can do only one of the following on its turns: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action.

payload.name: Abjure Foes
payload.description: Magic action using Channel Divinity. Target CHA mod creatures within 60 ft. WIS save or Frightened for 1 min.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Frightened ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.description: Your strikes now carry supernatural power. When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 12)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat.

features.name: Restoring Touch
features.description: When you use Lay On Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of the following conditions from the creature: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned. You must expend 5 Hit Points from the healing pool for each condition you remove; those points don't also restore Hit Points.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 16)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat.

features.name: Aura Expansion
features.description: Your Aura of Protection is now a 30-foot Emanation.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Truesight is recommended.
